name: Warm Soufflé & Crème Brûlée (Triton's / Lumiere's)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Whipped egg-and-sugar soufflé and baked vanilla custard have 0g fiber and melt on the tongue with zero mechanical work.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If you have a strict citrus/orange-peel guardrail, skip the Grand Marnier (orange liqueur) soufflé and order the Tahitian Vanilla Crème Brûlée (scrape off any berry garnish) or ask for plain vanilla bean sauce.
watchOuts: Grand Marnier contains orange peel extract (citrus guardrail)
Dairy cream/milk lactose — take a Lactaid pill
